reviews.comment: The professor provided clear instructions for homeworks and exams. The lectures were great and provided more than enough information. I wish this professor taught more online classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely a very well designed class. Professor Saxena clearly communicates what's expected of you and seems like a really nice person. Not a difficult class but a lot of learning can happen if you want it to. Homework and asynchronous exams are super reasonable and based on the lectures. If you are thinking about taking this section, take it!
Guaranteed A if you are literate. Entirely asynchronous, including exams. Lectures are straightforward, sometimes missing some info, but everything can be found online or in the textbook.

Class is well organized and pretty easy. 4-5 online video lectures each week. HW every couple weeks. Content isn't hard and exams are pretty easy (they are like 90% the same as the practice exam). Highly recommend for an easy A and you actually can learn a good amount about network security if you pay attention.

Very easy A. All homeworks and exam questions are directly from the lecture videos, which were very good at explaining. Canvas was very organized with how the class was structured. You could easily get by with an A without learning anything but I advise you to actually keep up with the material as it's interesting and he's a great lecturer.

Mickey mouse class (easy A). HWs are easy (4 in total) and answers are in lecture slides/videos. Midterm exam was exactly like the practice midterm. Final exam is a take home exam. Dude seems super chill and class is so easy. Honestly spent a total of 6 days working on this class the whole semester. Definitely recommend taking this section.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: An extremely well-structured online course with clear guidelines, instructions, and organization. Saxena is constantly emailing reminders about his assignments and making certain there is no ambiguity with his instructions. He is available for questions, but it is unlikely that will even be necessary. Highly recommend.
